title: Data Driven Modeling of Nonlinear Dynamics in a Rotating Detonation Combustor via Finite Dimensional Approximations of the Koopman Operator
summary: A Rotating Detonation Combustor (RDC) is a promising technology for increasing efficiency in propulsion and power generation applications. The dynamics of the RDC are governed by continuously propagating detonation waves within an annular combustion chamber. Multiple operating modes can be observed, including nonlinear interactions between counter-rotating waves and the emergence of standing wave patterns.
